[fixture header] CONSTRUCTED from jodi_item_names.txt, which is the capture.
One printed long name has been changed: the gas and diesel oil line now reads
'Gasoil and marine diesel' instead of 'Gas/diesel oil'. That is what a renamed
code looks like, and crack.sources.jodi must stop on it rather than carry on
calling a column gasoil on the strength of a code that no longer means what it
meant. No code token appears in this header, because the verifier reads the
words printed to the left of a code and a header that named one would be found
before the table.
A Guide on JODI-Oil World Database
Item Names
Last update: September 2017
This is a guide to indicates item and dimension names used in CSV files and their
corresponding full name in the JODI World Database (in world_primary, world_secondary
files).
Products
(ENERGY_PRODUCT)
World primary table World secondary table
Crude oil CRUDEOIL Liquefied petroleum gases LPG
NGL NGL Naphtha NAPHTHA
Other OTHERCRUDE Motor and aviation gasoline GASOLINE
Total TOTCRUDE Kerosenes KEROSENE
of which: kerosene type jet fuel JETKERO
Gasoil and marine diesel GASDIES
Fuel oil RESFUEL
Other oil products ONONSPEC
Total oil products TOTPRODS
Flows
(FLOW_BREAKDOWN)
World primary table World secondary table
Production INDPROD Refinery output REFGROUT
From other sources OSOURCES Receipts RECEIPTS
Imports TOTIMPSB Imports TOTIMPSB
Exports TOTEXPSB Exports TOTEXPSB
Products transferred/Backflows TRANSBAK Products transferred PTRANSF
Direct use DIRECUSE Interproduct transfers IPTRANSF
Stock change STOCKCH Stock change STOCKCH
Statistical difference STATDIFF Statistical difference STATDIFF
Refinery intake REFINOBS Demand TOTDEMO
Closing stocks CLOSTLV Closing stocks CLOSTLV
Countries
(REF_AREA)
Based on ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard* available at:
http://www.iso.org/iso/home/store/publication_item.htm?pid=PUB500001%3aen
*Except Kosovo, which currently doesn’t have official attribution of a two-letter code
Time
(TIME_PERIOD)
“yyyy-mm” format based on ISO 8601 standard
A Guide on JODI-Oil World Database
Item Names
Last update: September 2017
Units
(UNIT_MEASURE)
KBD Thousand Barrels per day (kb/d)
KBBL Thousand Barrels (kbbl)
KL Thousand Kilolitres (kl)
KTONS Thousand Metric Tons (kmt)
CONVBBL Conversion factor barrels/ktons
Colour Codes
(ASSESSMENT_CODE)
1 Results of the assessment show reasonable levels of comparability
2 Consult metadata/Use with caution
3 Data has not been assessed
4 Data under verification
For further inquiries, please contact JODIinfo@ief.org.
